frontMatter.title: Wednesday Navan Badminton Club Update
frontMatter.summary: No Club Night due to no available courts, but exciting matches are on with our Grade 7 Mixed 'A' team in the semi-final and Juvenile Club Night in full swing.

prev.title: Monday Club Night at Claremont: Get Ready!
prev.summary: Join us for an exciting Monday Club Night at Claremont with thrilling matches and fun games. No passports needed, just bring your rackets and enjoy the action!

next.title: Thursday Club Night: Exciting Badminton Matches
